name: duplicity loop
source:
[b]"Alice followed the white rabbit into a fantastical land where everything was topsy-turvy, and everyone was mad."[/b]

The story begins when Abriel falls into a Wonderland distinctly different from the story books: a world filled with magical girls devoted to fighting for the sake of the Queen. As Abriel tries to find her place in Wonderland and face her past, she must also face the reality of her situation: in Wonderland, nothing (everything) makes sense.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2708580/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
[b]“爱丽丝跟随小白兔进入了一个奇幻的国度，那里的一切都颠倒了，每个人都疯了。”[/b]

故事开始时，阿布莉尔陷入了一个与故事书截然不同的仙境：一个充满了为女王而奋斗的魔法女孩的世界。当阿布丽尔试图在仙境中找到自己的位置并面对自己的过去时，她也必须面对自己的现实处境：在仙境中，没有什么（一切）都是有意义的。

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2708580/]Steam[/url]]
